en: Section B. Interview.
zh: B节：访谈。

en: In this section, you will hear two interviews.
zh: 在这一节中，你将听到两段访谈。

en: At the end of each interview, five questions will be asked about what was said.
zh: 每段访谈结束后，将就刚才所说的内容提出五个问题。

en: Both the interviews and the questions will be spoken once only.
zh: 访谈和问题都只读一遍。

en: After each question, there will be a ten-second pause.
zh: 每个问题之后会有十秒钟的停顿。

en: During the pause, you should read the four choices, of A, B, C, and D, and mark the best answer to each question on answer sheet two.
zh: 请利用停顿时间阅读A、B、C、D四个选项，并在答题卡二上标出每题的最佳答案。

en: You have thirty seconds to preview the choices.
zh: 你有三十秒钟预览选项。

en: Now listen to the first interview.
zh: 现在请听第一段访谈。

en: Questions one to five are based on the first interview.
zh: 第1至5题根据第一段访谈提问。

en: Good evening, everybody.
zh: 大家晚上好。

en: Despite new promise of aid, international leaders provided disheartening assessments of the current battle against Ebola.
zh: 尽管有了新的援助承诺，国际领导人对当前抗击埃博拉疫情的形势仍给出了令人沮丧的评估。

en: The head of the World Bank said the international community—community had—“failed miserably” in its initial response.
zh: 世界银行行长说，国际社会在最初的应对中“败得很惨”。

en: The director of the Center for Disease Control said the situation reminded him of the early days of the AIDS epidemic.
zh: 美国疾病控制中心主任说，这种情况让他想起了艾滋病疫情初起时的情形。

en: We get our own assessment from one of the few nongovernmental groups treating patients in West Africa.
zh: 接下来，我们来听听在西非救治病人的少数几个非政府组织之一，如何评估当前形势。

en: International Medical Corps has built a treatment clinic in Liberia and is constructing other facilities in both Liberia and Sierra Leone.
zh: 国际医疗队已经在利比里亚建起一家治疗诊所，并正在利比里亚和塞拉利昂建设其他医疗设施。

en: Its president and CEO, Mary Johnson, joins me now.
zh: 该组织的总裁兼首席执行官玛丽·约翰逊现在来到我们节目中。

en: Thank you for joining us.
zh: 感谢您参加我们的节目。

en: Thank you, Jack.
zh: 谢谢你，杰克。

en: How many beds, how many facilities, how many people would you say that you’re engaged in treating now?
zh: 你们现在有多少床位、多少设施，大概正在为多少人提供治疗？

en: OK.
zh: 好的。

en: So, in Liberia, International Medical Corps opened up a 70-bed hospital —or actually we call it a treatment unit.
zh: 在利比里亚，国际医疗队开办了一家有70张床位的医院——准确地说，我们称之为治疗中心。

en: We opened that up in mid-September.
zh: 我们在九月中旬开始运营。

en: We are scaling up and we will be opening up another treatment unit in Sierra Leone.
zh: 我们正在扩大规模，还将在塞拉利昂开设另一个治疗中心。

en: In Liberia, we have about 200 people working in this treatment unit, trying to contain it, as well as treating people who have Ebola,
zh: 在利比里亚，约有200人在这家治疗中心工作，努力遏制疫情，同时治疗埃博拉患者，

en: with the hopes that they will recover, and they are recovering when they receive treatment.
zh: 希望他们能够康复；而患者接受治疗后也确实在逐渐康复。

en: Do you have any sense that the progress of this disease is being—is slowing?
zh: 您是否感觉到，这种疾病的发展势头正在——正在减缓？

en: Well, let me say that it’s clear that efforts, like ours and other organizations’, are working.
zh: 我想说，很明显，我们以及其他组织所作的努力正在发挥作用。

en: When there are treatment efforts, when there are health care workers to treat patients as they come in
zh: 只要开展救治，只要有医护人员来接诊患者

en: —I mean, our first patients that arrived to our treatment unit, they died at the doorstep.
zh: ——我是说，最早来到我们治疗中心的那些患者，就死在了门口。

en: But now we see that patients are recovering, and they’re returning back to their families.
zh: 但现在，我们看到患者在康复，而且正在回归家庭。

en: So any efforts around treatment and containment are working.
zh: 所以，围绕救治和控制疫情所作的努力都有效果。

en: The problem and the challenge is that there are just not enough operational efforts on the ground.
zh: 问题和挑战在于，当地切实开展的救援行动还远远不够。

en: That’s the challenge.
zh: 这就是面临的挑战。

en: Is that because a lack of international action or non-governmental action,
zh: 这是因为国际行动或非政府组织的行动不足，

en: or is it because the infrastructure in these communities is so difficult that even if you sent them 10 pop-up hospitals,
zh: 还是因为当地的基础设施条件太差，以至于即使送去十家临时医院，

en: they couldn’t build them?
zh: 他们也无法建起来？

en: OK.
zh: 好的。

en: Well, it’s a number of factors.
zh: 原因有很多。

en: One, certainly, the health care infrastructures are very weak in West Africa, under-resourced.
zh: 第一，西非的医疗基础设施确实非常薄弱，资源也很匮乏。

en: They don’t have enough health workers.
zh: 他们没有足够的医护人员。

en: That’s one thing.
zh: 这是其中一个原因。

en: The second thing is the spread wasn’t contained more quickly some months ago.
zh: 第二，几个月前，疫情传播未能得到更迅速的控制。

en: International donors are stepping up.
zh: 国际捐助方正在加大行动力度。

en: In fact, our treatment unit in Liberia was made possible from a grant from USAID’s Office of Foreign Disaster Assistance.
zh: 实际上，我们在利比里亚的治疗中心得以建立，靠的是美国国际开发署海外灾难援助办公室的一笔拨款。

en: It took $5 million to open that up and about a million a month.
zh: 建起这个中心花了500万美元，之后每个月大约还要100万美元。

en: So, part of it is the resources need to be there, but also people are really afraid.
zh: 所以，一方面必须有资源支持，另一方面，人们也确实很害怕。

en: They’re afraid to provide treatment because they also need to keep their own health workers safe.
zh: 他们不敢提供治疗，因为他们也必须保护自己医护人员的安全。

en: And so one of the things that we have done is we have said to other community health people as well as other international NGOs,
zh: 因此，我们采取的一项措施，就是告诉其他社区医护人员和国际非政府组织，

en: we will provide case management protocol training.
zh: 我们将提供病例管理规范培训。

en: We will train their workers so that they can open up more treatment facilities.
zh: 我们将培训他们的工作人员，让他们能够开设更多治疗设施。

en: The problem we have now is that the disease and the outbreak is being—is outpacing the operational efforts on the ground.
zh: 我们现在面临的问题是，疾病传播和疫情暴发的速度正在——正在超过当地救援行动的推进速度。

en: There are a lot of plans in place, by the way, to change that, and we’re still within that window.
zh: 顺便说一下，已经有许多计划在推进，以改变这种状况；而我们仍然处于能够采取行动的时机内。

en: Well, Mary, thank you very much for staying with us today.
zh: 玛丽，非常感谢您今天参加我们的节目。

en: You’re welcome.
zh: 不客气。

en: This is the end of the first interview.
zh: 第一段访谈到此结束。

en: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。

zh: 第1题：国际领导人对当前抗击埃博拉疫情的形势作出了怎样的评估？

en: Question 2. How many people are now working in the treatment unit in Liberia?
zh: 第2题：目前有多少人在利比里亚的治疗中心工作？

en: Question 3. According to Mary, what is the challenge in the battle against Ebola?
zh: 第3题：据玛丽所说，抗击埃博拉疫情面临的挑战是什么？

en: Question 4. Why do health workers need case management protocol training?
zh: 第4题：为什么医护人员需要接受病例管理规范培训？

zh: 第5题：这段访谈主要谈论什么？
